people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one buckler.
translations.bsb: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
translations.kjv: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
translations.asv: And king Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one buckler.
